method: Native production frames only during recording, normal steering/braking, real door transition, save/reprise action. Independent declared initial placement on a previously measured wide source road BEFORE recording. No positional repair during driving. Native film is not a 40km proof or hardware/perceptual validation.

fixture.method: Source junction plus boundary selected near an already physically traveled path; native controller must still cross both. No traveled distance is inferred.
